model: CoolMasterNet Fujitsu AJ*LCLAH outdoor unit (PRO) objects
equipment_type: VRF outdoor unit monitoring via BACnet gateway
applies_to: Fujitsu outdoor units AJT[40/45/54]LCLAH, AJY[40/45/54]LCLAH, AJCLCTAH, AJHLCLAH, AJQLCLAH, AOURLAVS, AJYLCLDH and AJHLCLDH (model codes as printed by CoolAutomation) read through a CoolAutomation gateway with PRO functionality.
summary: With PRO functionality, CoolAutomation gateways publish service data from Fujitsu AJ*LCLAH outdoor units over BACnet: type, capacity, operation, mode, defrost and oil recovery, compressor, valve, heater and fan states, thermistor temperatures, high and low pressure, compressor drive frequency, inverter temperature, DC voltage and current, fan frequency and EEV positions (25 objects). Monitoring only.
notes: Instance = VA x 256 + index (object identifier bits 21-8 = VA, 7-0 = index). Points shown for VA 1; the guide does not explain how outdoor units receive their VA.
Access set to read-only: these are measured service values, although the guide's type table lists PIV as read/write.
Object names are the guide's short names; descriptions are the guide's object descriptions with the bracketed unit moved to units.
Table printed on page 308 of the guide (section 3.2.9.2).
Md (Mode) states are from the guide's Fujitsu PRO Enumerated Parameters table.
The guide lists no error-code object for Fujitsu outdoor units.

source.title: BACnet Integration Guidelines - CoolMaster Product Line, CooLinkNet, CooLinkHub, CooLinkBridge

integration.summary: Use these objects to monitor Fujitsu outdoor equipment only; control stays on the CoolMasterNet indoor-unit objects. Map the outdoor block's VA and trend operation, mode, compressor frequency and pressures.
integration.enable: BACnet must be enabled on the gateway; these objects belong to its PRO (service data) functionality.
setup: BACnet MS/TP: activate on line L3 with 'line type L3 BAC' (L4-L7 also possible on the CoolMaster product line); default frame 9600 8N1, change with 'line baud L3 <rate>_8N1'; MAC (TS) default 0x40 = 64, change with 'line myid L3 <hex>'. Reboot after each change.
BACnet IP: enable with 'bacnet IP enable'; UDP port 47808 by default ('bacnet port <n>'). The server starts only once Ethernet is up with an IP address.
Default device instance 64 (0x40); change with 'bacnet instance <n>'.
gotchas: The guide does not document how VAs are assigned to outdoor units; confirm instances with a BACnet discovery.
This table has no outdoor-temperature object; TH3 is suction temperature.
